input.command:
perl -e 'alarm 20; exec @ARGV' hs -c '
_diag = { n = 0, flags = {} }
_diag.tap = hs.eventtap.new({hs.eventtap.event.types.flagsChanged}, function(e)
    _diag.n = _diag.n + 1; _diag.flags[#_diag.flags+1] = string.format("0x%x", e:rawFlags()); return false end)
_diag.tap:start()
local function f(x) local e=hs.eventtap.event.newEvent(); e:setType(hs.eventtap.event.types.flagsChanged); e:rawFlags(x); return e end
hs.timer.doAfter(0.2, function() f(0x840001):post() end)
hs.timer.doAfter(0.5, function() f(0):post() end)
return "diag tap started, accessibility=" .. tostring(hs.accessibilityState())' 2>&1 | tail -1
sleep 2
perl -e 'alarm 20; exec @ARGV' hs -c 'return "diag tap saw " .. tostring(_diag and _diag.n) .. " events: " .. table.concat(_diag and _diag.flags or {}, ",") .. " | tapEnabled=" .. tostring(_diag and _diag.tap:isEnabled())' 2>&1 | tail -1
input.description: Test whether a fresh tap receives posted events
